title: Snake
description: The classic snake game. Eat food, grow longer and avoid hitting yourself.
instructions: Guide the snake to the red food to grow longer and score points.
Do not run into the walls or into your own tail.
The snake speeds up as your score climbs, so stay sharp.
Your best score is saved on your device.
controls: Arrow keys or W A S D to steer on a keyboard
Swipe on the game area on phones and tablets
Press Space or tap to restart after game over
